head: Exterior Lights activation
tail: conflict between inner_lamp_fas_0428 (requires driver door closed) and inner_lamp_fas_0441 (no door requirement, only power ON)
conflict_note: inner_lamp_fas_0428 specifies 'driver side door closed' as prerequisite for exterior lights activation; inner_lamp_fas_0441 does not list door status but requires only vehicle power ON. This may reflect context difference: 0428 likely refers to automatic ambient-triggered activation (where door closure indicates occupant presence), while 0441 describes baseline functional enablement. Not a hard conflict — retain both with clarified semantics.
